# ATIA repository instructions

Read and follow the root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before editing this repository. These rules apply to every task, including work started from another computer.

- Fetch and compare `origin/main` before editing and immediately before pushing.
- Integrate remote commits with local work; preserve both sides' intended behavior. Never replace a newer tree with an older local copy.
- Stage only files changed for the current task, inspect the staged diff, and run relevant checks.
- Push only a normal fast-forward update to `main`. Never force-push or discard another person's uncommitted work.
